description: The negative control for props_corpus (tests/props_corpus.cpp): cases in props/notice-board.json's shape whose expectations are DELIBERATELY WRONG. props_corpus_negative passes only when the runner reports every one as differing and the run as failed. One case, through props.notices.generate.
sources: hand-written; each case is core's (conformance/props/notice-board.json) with one expected value changed, named by its new name

contract.order: assessment notices (assessmentHook) in posted order, then every other shown notice in posted order reversed (newest first)
contract.shown: an assessment notice always; otherwise fluency (absent or non-finite is 0) >= the difficulty's threshold; a difficulty outside the table always
contract.posting: a notice with no id is not posted; a second with a posted id is ignored
contract.hookState: from questStatus[questId]: active taken, completed done, unavailable locked, anything else or none offer; an offer this board has already raised quest_requested for reads requested (once per quest per board, every notice hooking that quest), until the host builds the board again with the new status
refusalOrder: then the action's own: answer no_question, answered, bad_index; take_quest no_quest, quest_not_offered
contract.select: selects it; the first read raises notice_read then reading_xp when readingXp > 0; a notice read before raises nothing
contract.takeQuest: while offer: quest_requested {quest, npc: the author's characterId or null}; the host then sends the quest lifecycle's offer {quest, npc} and accept {quest}

cases.name: generate: expected WRONGLY two notices for one NPC
